limitations: Actual supplier gears are exported but their meshing phases/backlash are not set or validated.
Rotation envelopes fill tooth gaps and web holes but preserve the large gears' continuous bores and face recesses. Small pinions conservatively include hubs and set-screw axial bounds.
The body shells intersect the gearbox. A lower side housing and new inner fixed-spindle supports must be designed; no enclosure fit is declared.
Motor flange-to-pinion transmission, output-to-thigh coupling, compound hub, shaft constraints and bearing seats remain unfinished.
The rear controller allocation changes aspect ratio at the same volume; it requires actual driver selection and layout.
